Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the model demo last week. Attached is Brightpath's first-pass redline to the DPA and the Order Form (Brightpath_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx). Two high-level asks up front: 

- We need to confirm the transfer mechanism for EU->US processing. Our counsel prefers the SCCs Annex III variant and a short Transfer Annex that references a list of permitted territories.
- We propose a narrow controller-processor split (Brightpath as controller for patient identifiers; Redwood as processor for model inference) but added language for a processor-subprocessor cascade and a right to audit clause.

Can Redwood confirm whether:
1) You can adopt Annex III SCCs as drafted, or if you require your own amendments.
2) KMS residency: are customer keys available in our EU-only region under Dedicated/Private? If not, we'll need contract-level guarantees.

Procurement is hoping for a commercial and legal response by end of week so we can hit our governance window. If helpful, we're available for a 30-minute call tomorrow morning (time slots in the attached OrderForm_Amendment_Draft.pdf).

Best,

Hi all — short legal triage after reviewing the tracked changes. Attaching our annotated response (redwood_response_dpa_v2.docx). Highlights: 

1) SCCs/Transfer Annex: Redwood can accept Annex III language with two guarded exceptions: (a) we need an explicit carveout that prohibits using customer data for model training unless separately contracted; (b) the Transfer Annex should refer to our EU-hosted endpoints by name rather than an open territorial list.

2) KMS / key residency: We can commit to EU key residency for Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted plans we'll offer bring-your-own-key for EU regions with the caveat that HSM-backed KMS is availability-dependent. Jonas — please confirm the exact region codes and SLA for key escrow.

3) Subprocessor cascade and right-to-audit: we will accept a scoped audit clause limited to production security reports and remediation evidence. No full on-prem audit. We'll propose a 30-day notice period for new subprocessors and an emergency substitution process with post-notification.

Next steps we propose:
- Technical tie-out (Jonas + Sara) for KMS and region naming — 30 minutes.
- We will produce an Order Form amendment that references the Transfer Annex and enumerates EU endpoints; draft attached (OrderForm_Amendment_Draft.pdf).

Olga — if that suits, I'll prepare the DocuSign-ready package after the technical tie-out.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Staff Counsel, Redwood Inference
